ref_entities: build a python module to fit a BART model on torch tensor training data with MCMC sampling
create a function that uses a fitted BART model to predict responses on new covariate data
create a function that returns BART predictions with configurable quantile intervals for uncertainty estimation
build a python module to fit an accelerated XBART model with adaptive tree count and variable weights
create a function that draws posterior predictive samples from a fitted BART model for uncertainty analysis
build a python module to propose a Bayesian additive regression tree using the grow-from-root algorithm
create a function that presorts input data to generate the O index matrix for each dimension
test the cut point sampling method that selects splits using integrated log-likelihood probabilities
refactor the sift method to partition data into left and right sorted invariants during tree recursion
review the recursive grow-from-root strategy that builds tree nodes by sampling variables and cut points
build a GrowPruneTreeProposer instance with a custom grow probability for BART tree sampling
run propose on a GrowPruneTreeProposer to perform a Metropolis-Hastings grow or prune mutation on a BART tree
review the MutationKind enum with grow and prune operation values for tree mutation types
test the log transition ratio calculation for grow and prune mutations in BART tree proposals
summarize the log structure ratio computation using alpha and beta hyperparameters for BART tree priors
create a LeafNode with a depth, composite rules, and optional prediction value
build a SplitNode with left and right child nodes and composite split rules
test the BaseNode data_in_node method to condition covariate and response tensors on composite rules
refactor the LeafNode grow_node static method to convert a leaf into a SplitNode with new children
review the SplitNode prune_node static method to convert a prunable split node back into a LeafNode
create a NoiseStandardDeviation instance with inverse-gamma prior concentration and rate hyperparameters
sample the noise standard deviation from the posterior given covariate data and model residuals
create a LeafMean sampler with prior location and scale parameters for BART leaf nodes
sample a leaf node mean value from the normal prior distribution
sample a leaf node mean from the posterior given a LeafNode, data, and current sigma
create a SplitRule with a grow dimension, threshold value, and comparison operator
build a DimensionalRule representing a min-max range along a single feature dimension
add a SplitRule to a DimensionalRule to tighten the min or max bounds
condition a PyTorch tensor on CompositeRules to get a boolean mask of matching rows
add a SplitRule to CompositeRules returning an immutable copy with the new rule appended
build a python module to create a BART Tree and generate predictions from a covariate tensor
create a function that finds all growable leaf nodes in a BART Tree given input data
test the Tree class mutate method by applying a GrowMutation or PruneMutation to the tree structure
review the Tree class prunable_split_nodes method to find decision nodes with two leaf children
summarize the Tree class num_nodes and split_nodes methods to inspect overall tree structure
